name: Card Chaos💥
desc:
💥 The most chaotic game on ROBLOX. Stack over 75 unique cards to make insane builds and crush your opponents in this 2.5D shooter! Best enjoyed with friends.

USE CODE "RHYS" FOR 1 UNIQUE SPIN TOKEN!
USE CODE "WEOW" FOR 2300 CASH

NEXT CODE AT 17,000 LIKES

📱 Playable on PC, Console and Mobile!
❗ Mobile and Console support are all work in progress, we're working to improve them as much as possible!
⚡ Make sure to play on a fast & stable internet connection and the highest graphics possible for best experience!


💻 CONTROLS:
Shoot – Left Click/RT
Jump - Spacebar/LB or X(Hold for more height)
Block - Right Click/LT 
Wall Cling - Jump and move in direction of wall
Descend - Press S/Move your thumbstick down

Thumbnails by WolverGuy and Numberless
Strongly based on Modded ROUNDS and Stick Fight. This is a solo deved project, so expect and report any bugs you find!
Stats and rewards will not apply in private servers. Exploiters will be banned with no chance of appeal.
